name: HSBC HKD Stablecoin
oneLiner: HKD-HSBC is HSBC's pre-launch HKD stablecoin, HKMA-licensed in April 2026 with H2 2026 launch planned via PayMe and the HSBC HK app.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
pegMechanism: Pre-launch HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin licensed by the HKMA; expected to maintain 1:1 HKD backing with segregated high-quality liquid reserve assets and regulated mint/redemption channels once HSBC launches the business

applicabilityBasis.summary: HKD-HSBC is a pre-launch HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin licensed by HKMA and planned for 1:1 HKD redemption.

genius.issuerEntity: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
genius.notes: HSBC holds an HKMA stablecoin issuer licence for a planned HKD stablecoin, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was found.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS NPRM and reporting-form notices
OCC digital asset licensing applications tracker
NCUA PPSI application and standards proposals
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state-qualified approval, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was located for HKD-HSBC or HSBC Hong Kong.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: HKD-HSBC resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

launchPhaseDetail: HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer FRS02, effective April 10 2026; launch expected in the coming months / H2 2026 with integration into PayMe (3.3M users) and HSBC HK App; peer-to-peer payments and tokenized investment subscriptions; 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated accounts; symbol and ticker not yet confirmed

featuredContent.description: HSBC plans to integrate HKD stablecoin into PayMe and HSBC HK App for peer-to-peer payments and tokenized investment subscriptions.

milestones.title: HKMA grants stablecoin issuer licence to HSBC
milestones.description: The HKMA grants The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited a stablecoin issuer licence under the Stablecoins Ordinance, effective April 10 2026.
